cases.sentence: ___ одного богатого человека принесла ему хороший урожай.
cases.translation: The land of a certain rich man produced a good harvest.
cases.explain: Земля is the subject of принесла (produced) — subjects take the nominative.

cases.sentence: Земля одного богатого ___ принесла ему хороший урожай.
cases.translation: The land of a certain rich man produced a good harvest.
cases.explain: Человека shows possession ('of a man') — the possessive modifier takes the genitive.

cases.sentence: ...как у тех слуг, что ждут возвращения своего хозяина со свадебного ___.
cases.translation: ...like those servants waiting for their master's return from the wedding feast.
cases.explain: Со (a form of с, meaning 'from') takes the genitive → пира, 'from the feast'.

cases.sentence: Кто-то в толпе сказал ___, «Учитель, скажи моему брату, чтобы он разделил со мной наследство».
cases.translation: Someone in the crowd said to Jesus, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
cases.explain: Иисусу is the indirect object of сказал (said to) → dative.

cases.translation: Sell your possessions and give to the poor.
cases.explain: Милостыню is the direct object of the transitive verb давайте (give) → accusative; feminine -я nouns take -ю in the accusative.

cases.translation: And he told them a parable.
cases.explain: Притчу is the direct object of рассказал (told) → accusative; feminine -а nouns take -у in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Кто тогда окажется верным и разумным управляющим, которого хозяин поставил над другими ___?
cases.translation: Who then is the faithful and wise manager whom the master put in charge of his other servants?
cases.explain: Над (over) always takes the instrumental; слугами is instrumental plural — 'over the other servants'.

cases.sentence: Когда вас приведут на суд в ___, к правителям и властьимущим, не беспокойтесь о том, как вам защитить себя.
cases.translation: When they bring you to trial in the synagogue, before the rulers and authorities, do not worry about how you will defend yourselves.
cases.explain: В marking a stationary location takes the prepositional → синагоге, 'in the synagogue'.

reading.question: What does Jesus warn his disciples to beware of?
options: The yeast of the Pharisees, that is, hypocrisy
reading.correct: The yeast of the Pharisees, that is, hypocrisy
reading.explain: Jesus says, "Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy."

reading.ru: Однако ни один из них не забыт Богом.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about the sparrows sold for small coins?
options: Not one of them is forgotten by God
They are more valuable than people
reading.correct: Not one of them is forgotten by God
reading.explain: Even lowly sparrows, sold cheaply, are not forgotten by God — so people, worth more than sparrows, need not fear.

reading.ru: Всякий, кто скажет что-либо против Сына Человеческого, будет прощен, но тот, кто кощунствует над Святым Духом, не будет прощен.
reading.question: According to Jesus, which sin will not be forgiven?
options: Speaking against the Son of Man
reading.explain: Speaking against the Son of Man can be forgiven, but blaspheming the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

reading.ru: потому что Святой Дух в тот самый час научит вас, что вам говорить.
reading.question: What will happen when the disciples are brought to trial before rulers?
options: The Holy Spirit will teach them what to say
They will be freed without a trial
reading.correct: The Holy Spirit will teach them what to say
reading.explain: Jesus tells them not to worry, because the Holy Spirit will teach them in that hour what they must say.

reading.ru: Земля одного богатого человека принесла ему хороший урожай.
reading.question: What happens at the start of the parable of the rich fool?
options: A rich man's land produces an abundant harvest
A rich man loses all his land
reading.correct: A rich man's land produces an abundant harvest
reading.explain: The parable begins with the land of a rich man producing a good harvest.

reading.ru: Но Бог сказал ему, «Глупец, сегодня же ночью твою жизнь возьмут у тебя, кому достанется все, что ты приготовил».
reading.question: What does God say to the rich man who plans to store his abundant harvest?
options: His life will be demanded of him that very night
He should build even bigger barns
He will live a hundred more years
He should give everything away immediately
reading.correct: His life will be demanded of him that very night
reading.explain: God calls him a fool and tells him his life will be taken from him that very night.

reading.ru: Так будет с каждым, кто копит богатство для себя, но не приобретает богатство для Бога.
reading.question: What is the lesson of the parable of the rich fool?
options: It is foolish to store up wealth for yourself but not be rich toward God
Only the poor can enter God's Kingdom
reading.correct: It is foolish to store up wealth for yourself but not be rich toward God
reading.explain: The parable warns against hoarding riches for oneself instead of being rich toward God.

reading.ru: Посмотрите на воронов, они не сеют и не жнут, у них нет ни хранилищ, ни амбаров, однако Бог питает их.
reading.question: What example does Jesus give to teach against worrying?
options: The ravens, which God feeds though they neither sow nor reap
The lilies of the field only
The sparrows sold in the market
reading.correct: The ravens, which God feeds though they neither sow nor reap
reading.explain: Jesus points to the ravens, which have no storehouse or barn, yet God feeds them.

reading.ru: Но если Бог так одевает траву на поле, которая сегодня есть, а завтра будет брошена в печь, то не оденет ли он и вас, маловеры?
reading.question: What does Jesus say about God's care for the grass of the field?
options: If God clothes short-lived grass so beautifully, he will surely clothe people too
Grass is more valuable than people
God does not care about plants
reading.correct: If God clothes short-lived grass so beautifully, he will surely clothe people too
reading.explain: If God so clothes grass that lives only a day, he will much more clothe those of little faith.

reading.ru: Блаженны те слуги, которых хозяин, возвратившись, найдет бодрствующими.
reading.question: Who are called blessed in the parable of the watchful servants?
options: The servants the master finds watching when he returns
The servants who sleep all night
The servants who leave the house
reading.correct: The servants the master finds watching when he returns
reading.explain: Blessed are the servants whom the master finds awake and watching when he returns.

reading.ru: Кому было много дано, с того много и потребуют, и кому было много доверено, с того много и спросится.
reading.question: What principle does Jesus state about those given much responsibility?
options: More will be required of those to whom much was given
Everyone will be judged equally regardless of what they were given
Those given much are exempt from judgment
Only servants, not masters, will be judged
reading.correct: More will be required of those to whom much was given
reading.explain: "To whomever much is given, of him will much be required."

reading.ru: Я пришел принести огонь на землю, и как я хочу, чтобы он уже разгорелся.
reading.question: What does Jesus say he came to bring, using the image of fire?
options: Fire on the earth, which he wishes were already kindled
reading.correct: Fire on the earth, which he wishes were already kindled
reading.explain: Jesus says he came to bring fire to the earth and wishes it were already burning.

reading.ru: Семья из пяти человек разделится, трое против двоих и двое против троих.
reading.question: What does Jesus say his coming will cause within families?
options: Division, with family members set against one another
reading.correct: Division, with family members set against one another
reading.explain: Jesus says a household of five will be divided, three against two and two against three.

reading.ru: Говорю тебе, что ты не выйдешь оттуда, пока не выплатишь все до самого последнего гроша.
reading.question: What warning does Jesus give about settling with an accuser on the way to court?
options: You will not get out of prison until you have paid the very last penny
The judge will always show mercy
You should never settle out of court
The accuser will forgive the debt
reading.correct: You will not get out of prison until you have paid the very last penny
reading.explain: Jesus warns that if you end up in prison, you will not leave until you have paid the very last penny.
